Are you constantly running out of USB ports on your laptop or PC? Upgrade your workspace connectivity with our versatile 7 Port USB Hub from Compshop. This essential accessory instantly expands your device's USB 2.0 capabilities, allowing you to connect multiple peripherals simultaneously without the hassle of constantly plugging and unplugging. Designed for efficiency and convenience, this USB splitter features individual on/off switches for each port, giving you complete control over your connected devices and helping to conserve power. Perfect for home, office, or travel, this data hub simplifies your digital life.

Key Features

  • Seven USB 2.0 Ports: Instantly add seven high-speed USB 2.0 ports to any compatible device, solving your connectivity challenges.
  • Independent On/Off Switches: Each port features its own power switch, allowing you to control power to individual devices and preserve battery life.
  • Bright LED Indicators: Clearly see which USB port is active at a glance with dedicated LED indicators for each connection.
  • Plug-and-Play Simplicity: No drivers or complicated setup required – simply plug in the 7 Port USB Hub and start connecting your devices.
  • Wide Compatibility: Connect your mouse, keyboard, external hard drives, flash drives, printers, cameras, and more to your PC or laptop.
  • Compact & Portable Design: Lightweight and easy to carry, making this USB expander ideal for travel, office, home, and school use.

FAQ

What devices can I connect to this 7 Port USB Hub?
You can connect a wide range of USB-enabled devices such as mice, keyboards, external hard drives, USB flash drives, printers, webcams, and more to expand your computer's capabilities.
Does this USB hub require external power?
No, this 7 Port USB Hub is designed for plug-and-play operation and typically draws power directly from your computer's USB port. No external power adapter is usually needed for most common devices.
What is the benefit of individual on/off switches?
Individual switches allow you to turn off power to specific ports when not in use. This helps conserve your laptop's battery life, reduces power consumption, and allows you to manage connected devices without unplugging them.
Is this hub compatible with USB 3.0 or USB-C devices?
This hub features USB 2.0 ports and is backward compatible with USB 1.1. While it will work with USB 3.0 or USB-C devices, data transfer speeds will be limited to USB 2.0 specifications. For optimal performance with USB 3.0 or USB-C devices, consider a dedicated hub for those standards.
